extraction_notes: Some principal refund amounts were illegible or combined for multiple flats in the Final Order table (pages 18-19), hence left as null and noted in reasoning. Handwritten corrections in the 'Amount Paid' table were used where clear. A consistent cost of Rs. 10,000/- per complaint was inferred for each complaint as per the Final Order on page 22. The 'primary_order' refers to the Final Order dated 18th Feb 2020. Supplementary proceedings include the Non-Compliance Order dated 4th July 2023 (covering 16 complaints as listed on pages 10-12) and the specific Recovery Warrant dated 18th July 2023 (for one complaint, CC006000000141027, as detailed on pages 1-9).
